# Behaviour reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm gen-docs`. Do not edit by hand — edit the schema and re-run. -->

Every behaviour a scene can attach to an object, with the parameters it accepts.

**This page is generated from the engine's own schemas**, which are the same schemas that
validate a scene at load time. There is no second description of what `chaseOnSight` accepts
that could disagree with the first. A parameter added to the code appears here on the next
`pnpm gen-docs`, and CI fails if somebody forgets to run it.

A behaviour is **data, never code**. The document names a `type` and carries plain `params`;
there are no expression strings and nothing is interpreted. A scene written by a newer build
still opens in an older one — the unknown behaviour is reported and skipped rather than making
the whole scene unopenable.

## Contents

- [`chaseOnSight`](#chaseonsight) — Chase on sight
- [`checkpoint`](#checkpoint) — Checkpoint
- [`patrol`](#patrol) — Patrol
- [`pickup`](#pickup) — Pickup

## chaseOnSight

**Chase on sight.** Patrols until it sees the player, then chases and attacks. Composes with a Patrol behaviour.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sightRange` | `number` | `18` | at least 1; at most 200 |
| `fieldOfView` | `number` | `140` | at least 10; at most 360 |
| `chaseSpeed` | `number` | `4` | at least 0.5; at most 30 |
| `attackRange` | `number` | `2` | at least 0.5; at most 20 |
| `attackDamage` | `number` | `10` | at least 0; at most 1000 |
| `attackInterval` | `number` | `1.2` | at least 0.1; at most 30 |
| `health` | `number` | `30` | at least 1; at most 10000 |
| `loseInterestAfter` | `number` | `4` | at least 0; at most 60 |
| `despawnOnDeath` | `boolean` | `true` | — |

### Example

```json
{
  "type": "chaseOnSight",
  "params": {
    "sightRange": 18,
    "fieldOfView": 140,
    "chaseSpeed": 4,
    "attackRange": 2
  }
}
```

## checkpoint

**Checkpoint.** Becomes the place the player comes back to on death, and saves progress. Configure what it restores.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | `number` | `2.5` | at least 0.2; at most 30 |
| `reset` | `object` | `{}` | — |
| `repeatable` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `sfxEvent` | `string` | `"checkpoint"` | at most 64 |

### Example

```json
{
  "type": "checkpoint",
  "params": {
    "radius": 2.5,
    "reset": {},
    "repeatable": false,
    "sfxEvent": "checkpoint"
  }
}
```

## patrol

**Patrol.** Walks between waypoints, looping or bouncing back along the path.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `waypoints` | `[number, number, number][]` | `[]` | — |
| `speed` | `number` | `2` | at least 0; at most 50 |
| `mode` | `"loop" | "pingPong"` | `"loop"` | — |
| `faceDirection` | `boolean` | `true` | — |
| `waitSeconds` | `number` | `0` | at least 0; at most 60 |

### Example

```json
{
  "type": "patrol",
  "params": {
    "waypoints": [],
    "speed": 2,
    "mode": "loop",
    "faceDirection": true
  }
}
```

## pickup

**Pickup.** Gives the player a weapon, ammo or health when they walk into it. Stays put if it would give nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"weapon" | "ammo" | "health"` | `"health"` | — |
| `weaponId` | `string` | `""` | at most 128 |
| `amount` | `number` | `25` | at least 0; at most 9999 |
| `radius` | `number` | `1.5` | at least 0.2; at most 20 |
| `respawnSeconds` | `number` | `0` | at least 0; at most 600 |
| `sfxEvent` | `string` | `"pickup"` | at most 64 |
| `spin` | `boolean` | `true` | — |

### Example

```json
{
  "type": "pickup",
  "params": {
    "kind": "health",
    "weaponId": "",
    "amount": 25,
    "radius": 1.5
  }
}
```
